checks.text: The page shows the heading "Image To PDF" and the text "No images yet".
Clicking the button "Add image" adds a list item containing "Image 1" and the text "1280 x 720"; the text "No images yet" is gone.
Clicking "Add image" a second time adds a list item containing "Image 2" and the text "800 x 600"; the list now shows two items in order "Image 1" then "Image 2".
Clicking the button "Move up" on the list item "Image 2" reorders the list so "Image 2" appears before "Image 1".
Clicking the button "Delete Image 1" removes that item; the list now shows only "Image 2" and the summary text "Pages: 1".
Selecting "A4" in the select labelled "Page size" and clicking the button "Download PDF" triggers a download of a file named "images.pdf" with a size greater than 0 bytes.
Selecting "Letter" in the select labelled "Page size" and clicking "Download PDF" triggers a download of a file named "images.pdf"; the file size differs from the A4 download size.
After adding "Image 1" and "Image 2", reloading the page still shows both list items in the order "Image 1" then "Image 2" and the summary text "Pages: 2".
Reload keeps the page size setting: after selecting "A4" in the select labelled "Page size" and reloading, the select still shows "A4".
